The main takeaway from our work is that
researchers and evaluators of programs should use measures that are invariant and have evidence of validity across gender and ethnic groups to make meaningful comparisons across groups.
researchers and practitioners should consider the potential for gender and racial/ethnic differences in their assessment and evaluation work.
researchers should test measurement invariance before comparing means between groups. (PsycINFO Database Record (c) 2019 APA, all rights reserved)
